# Chef A fella has gotta eat, and it's the chef's job to make sure folks have something other than junk to munch on.
[textlink="Click here to see a list of food recipes." link="Food"]
First and foremost, you'll need to familiarize yourself with the kitchen, and the tools available to you.
## Kitchen Prep:
Here's a few basics to help figure out your plan for the round.
- Check what you have on hand when it comes to ingredients, most kitchens have some Flour, Rice, Eggs, Monkey Cubes, and a few other things to get started with. - Try your hand at mixing up some dough by putting water and flour together in a beaker. (Use the sinks!) - Check the Food Recipes guidebook for things you can make, and put all the listed ingredients into a microwave to cook it into a meal. - Try not to spend the entire round in the kitchen! While food is important, keep in mind your [textlink="Objectives" link="OrganizationsAndSecretIdentities"].
## Extra Kitchen Tips Grow whatever plants you need! If you need help take a look at [textlink="botany's guide" link="Botany"].
Milk can be collected by Alt-Clicking on a Cow with a container in your hand. (Beakers, Buckets, Milk Jugs, ect.)
You can butcher monkeys after they die and are dragged onto on a meatspike. It's best to do this in the freezer, as the results are... messy.
